QuestInfo.name: Seizing the Ores
QuestInfo.2: Just as you completed the mission for #b#p3001000##k, an urgent message arrived. What's going on?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:

0.0: I have gone over all of the information, and it looks like we may have to commit to a major offensive sooner rather than later. We must prepare well for the coming battles...\r\n
0.1: Before things really heat up, I would like you to bring us some supplies.
0.2: Specters are using their laborers to mine ore from the mountains. This has cut off an important resource of ours.
0.3: Ores are a must if we are to craft and repair our weapons and armors. Your next mission is collecting #b#t4000729##k items from #r#o2400108##k monsters. You'll do this for us, won't you?
0.4: Great. Please eliminate #r#o2400108##k monsters to slow down their mining and get #b30 #t4000729##k items.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)

yes.0: Our troops can't fight without weapons and armor. Bring me #b30 #t4000729##k items.

no.0: This is no time for slacking!

1.0: I hope you've brought us a hefty load of materials.

yes.0: That wasn't so hard, was it? If we keep this up, we'll be ready to attack in no time.
yes.1: Just a moment. I've received an urgent message...

item.0: We need far more #b#t4000729##k items, as you know. I need at least #30# to expand our equipment reserve.

mob.0: You must defeat at least #r100#k #b#o2400108## troops to make an impact on their supply lines.
